_comment: ROUND-4 pipeline config (run_training.py): MIXED static+driving 5G pool (21 traces, ~11.4h) — driving traces reintroduced now that integral serialization (42b7389) makes deep fades realistic. This gives real adaptation headroom (capacity crosses the ladder 57-76% of the time) vs the too-easy static-only regime. All hyperparameters are SETTLED (S=8, mu=4.3, bounded reward), so no wide grid: two targeted ablations (lstm_pred; reward v1 vs v2 with startup/drop terms matching QoE'' v2) x 12 seeds + a 4-trace held-out eval (fixed split, --split-seed decoupled from RL seed). Goal: shrink the round-3 seed std (74.6 ± 19.8) and show the DQN beating fixed arms in the harder regime. Commit this file with any change: a run is fully described by repo state.

lstm._signal: achieved = train on per-SEGMENT achieved-throughput series generated by gen_lstm_dataset.py under the current transport model (matches what the predictor is FED at inference); capacity = legacy DL_bitrate training
lstm._gen_args: 8 offsets because segment-level series are short (~30 samples per 300-frame episode at S=10) — more windows keep the sequence count healthy
lstm._sequence_length: 8 (was 20): at S=10 an episode only yields ~30 throughput samples, so seq_len 20 would leave the predictor cold for 2/3 of the episode

dqn_sweep._seeds: ROUND 4: TWELVE training seeds per config (up from 8). Combined with the fixed 4-trace held-out eval (--split-seed 42, decoupled from RL seed) and the non-trivial mixed regime, this is the primary variance-reduction lever. sweep.py reports mean ± std + per-seed + per-trace. Ship a representative (median) seed, not the best.
dqn_sweep._base_args: eval-seeds: every held-out eval averages 3 jitter seeds (kills the one-off-spike checkpoint problem). playback-rate-min 0.9 = research-backed imperceptible slowdown floor. reward-spec fixed to the round-1 winner shape.
dqn_sweep._axes: ROUND 4: S=8 FIXED (round-3 winner; S=5≈S=8 tied), mu=4.3 FIXED. TWO axes: (a) lstm_pred ablation re-tested on the high-volatility driving regime (expected: still irrelevant — driving traces are less autocorrelated); (b) reward-shape ablation, v1 (settled round-1 bounded shape) vs v2 (+startup_weight 1.0 +drop_weight 1.0, mirroring the QoE″ v2 terms) — tests whether charging cold-start waiting during training improves startup behavior now that traces keep their near-zero idle-attach openings. 2 lstm x 2 reward x 12 seeds = 48 trials (~round-2 scale). The axis value overrides base_args.reward-spec.

final_eval._segment_frames: run_training.py evaluates at the WINNING S from dqn_sweep_results.json; this value is only the fallback when no sweep result exists.
